new_promises.statement: Smartphone camera modules volume can increase to 190 to 200 million units per annum in the next two to three years.
new_promises.quote: we feel confident that the volume of smartphone camera modules can increase from 40 million units and revenues by INR 2,000 crores in large financial years to 190 to 200 million units per annum
new_promises.speaker: Atul Lall

new_promises.statement: Smartphone camera modules revenue to reach closer to INR 6,000 crores to INR 7,000 crores in the next two to three years.
new_promises.quote: with the revenue closer to INR 6,000 crores to INR 7,000 crores and sub-10% EBITDA margins in the next two to three years.
new_promises.speaker: Atul Lall

new_promises.statement: Investment commitment of approximately INR 3,000 crores over the next three years for components ECMS applications.

new_promises.statement: IT business revenue in next two years should be around Rs. 4,000 crores to Rs. 5,000 crores.

new_promises.statement: IT products business can reach $1.5 billion to $2 billion domestic market business for Dixon.
